llm_summary: The overall sentiment toward *The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA* is highly positive, with users frequently identifying it as an essential, budget-friendly "holy grail" moisturizer. Fans love its simple, effective formula that provides reliable hydration without the use of irritating fragrances or essential oils. While it is widely praised as a staple, some users with specific skin concerns or severe barrier damage note that it is a basic product and may not be sufficient on its own to resolve complex skin issues.
